solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

flags: minor: all three wrong choices fail for the same reason (each reduces to 3x + 2y = 180); the one non-proportional choice stands out once a student checks one, though this is the concept being tested
Q082-01.notes: 15x+10y=900 gives 3x+2y=180. A: 2x+3y=170 is independent, so x=40, y=30. B: 3x+2y=180 is the same equation. C: 6x+4y=360 is the same equation. D: 18x+12y=1080 is the same equation.

Q082-03.notes: The extra 10% discount is 0.10P = 33.60-28.80 = 4.80, so P=48 (p=30, and 0.7*48=33.6 checks).

Q082-04.notes: L+H<=50 and H>=L+8, so 2L+8<=50 and L<=21 (bags of 21 and 29 kg).

flags: minor: the family of SAT items on 'cx + a = bx + d' with no or infinitely many solutions is familiar, but this item does not closely copy a known released question
Q082-05.notes: (c-3)x = 4(c-3). Exactly one solution requires c != 3, so x=4.

flags: minor: summing an arithmetic series is not an explicit digital SAT skill, although students can add 11 values by brute force or use 11*f(6)
Q082-06.notes: The slope is 18/6=3, so f(x)=3x+1. The sum is 11*f(6) = 11*19 = 209.

flags: minor: 0.035 hospitals per thousand people (35 per million) is about twice the real US rate, which is high but tolerable
Q082-07.notes: 1.2 million people is 1200 thousand, and 0.035*1200 = 42. Trap choices: A uses 1.2 as the input, B uses y(1.2), and D adds the intercept.

Q082-08.notes: The x values are unevenly spaced. Per unit of x the increases are 2.6, 2.65, 2.5, 2.7 and 2.7, so the data are linear with a slope of about 2.6. C (3.7) is the change per row, 18.5/5. B is the trap of ignoring the x gaps. A is wrong because the ratios fall from 1.22 toward 1.10.

flags: minor: 'About 3.6' can be eliminated because a median of integer scores must be an integer or a half-integer
Q082-09.notes: Combined counts for scores 1 to 5 are 7, 8, 5, 7 and 17, so the cumulative counts are 7, 15, 20, 27 and 44. The 22nd and 23rd values are both 4. Distractors: A is the average of the class medians (2 and 5), B is the weighted average of the medians (160/44), and D is class 2's median.

Q082-10.notes: In 8 parts of dough the water is 3 + 0.12*5 = 3.6, and 3.6/8 = 45%. The values are realistic (60% baker's hydration and about 12% flour moisture).

Q082-11.notes: Rent per square foot is 2.25, 1.85, 1.97, 1.90, 1.89, 2.10, 1.86 and 2.04. Five apartments are under $2.00, and two of them have 2 bedrooms (1800/950 and 1950/1050), so the probability is 2/5.

flags: minor: choices C and D both have a rate of 12 L/min (they tie), so neither can be the unique answer; this is an elimination shortcut
Q082-12.notes: Rates are 90/5=18, 210/15=14, 120/10=12 and 180/15=12 L/min. B is the trap of picking the largest volume change.
